steps.title: Delivery note in the house
steps.text: Go to your player-owned house portal, and attempt to enter your house.
Read the delivery note and accept the quest.
Attempt to enter your house again and select the 'A Clockwork Syringe' option once more.
Investigate the large crate.
Kill the level 98 Barrelchest Mk II.

steps.title: Dealing with the delivery
steps.text: Talk to the estate agent.
Interrogate the zombie head.
Torture the head using all five options, once maximum stress, talk to the head again.

postconditions.text: Now I need to go and warn Bill

steps.title: Warning Bill Teach
steps.text:
With the zombie head, talk to Bill Teach on Mos Le'Harmless, either in The Other Inn or on The Adventurous ship.
  • Head to the docks of Port Phasmatys, cross the gangplank on the easternmost ship, right-click travel via Bill Teach to travel to Mos Le'Harmless.
  • Alternatively, charter a ship directly to Mos Le'Harmless from Port Sarim.
Walk north to Harpoon Joe's House of 'Rum', sit in the chair in the north-east corner and ask for a 'Long Drop'.
Talk to Bill.
Place-evidence on table nearby to set the zombie head on top.
Talk to Bill again.
Climb-up the ladder.

steps.title: Finding the workers
steps.text: Select-spell with the pirate spell sheet in your backpack to travel to Braindeath Island.

neededItems.name: Fishbowl Helmet (can be reclaimed during quest if destroyed)
Diving apparatus (can be reclaimed during quest if destroyed)

steps.text:
Go directly west and talk to Captain Braindeath.
  • Also get a diving apparatus and a fishbowl helmet from him, if you don't already have them.

Go to the Braindeath Island 'Rum'-geon entrance:
  • Optional: If you have it, activate the Dungeoneering cape to travel directly there, skipping these steps.
Equip your diving apparatus and fishbowl helmet.

Enter the mysterious entrance.
  • Optional: kill a crab in order to complete the hard Daemonheim achievement Alcrabholic.
Go down the west path and search the dead brewers to discover his names.
steps.warning: Ensure you've seen the name of the brewer in the conversation window, the quest plugin might not fully detect this.

postconditions.text: I'll see if I can find his name badge

steps.text: Go down the middle path and search the dead brewer to discover his names
steps.warning: Ensure you've seen the name of the brewer in the conversation window, the quest plugin might not fully detect this.

postconditions.text: I'll see if I can find his name badge

steps.text: Go down the middle path and search the dead brewer to discover his names
steps.warning: Ensure you've seen the name of the brewer in the conversation window, the quest plugin might not fully detect this.

postconditions.text: I'll see if I can find his name badge

steps.text: Return to Captain Braindeath and receive the Twiblick night special.

actions.text: I found the three missing brewers...

steps.text: Teleport back to Mos Le'Harmless with the pirate spell sheet.
Return to the basement in Joe's pub.
Talk to Bill and receive the unlocked Twiblick night special.
Open the box.

postconditions.text: but I'm not sure I want to

steps.text: Talk to Bill again.

actions.text: How are we going to use this to get information?

postconditions.text: Time to choose how we make

steps.text: Talk to Bill again.

steps.title: Getting into Bloodsplatter Isle
steps.text: Return south to Bill's ship, cross the gangplank, talk to him, and use the 'A Clockwork Syringe' option to begin your travel.
Talk to Bill.

actions.text: Awesome! I'll get right on it!

postconditions.text: That's what I like about ye

steps.text: Climb-down two ladders to the hold of the ship (lowest level).
Open and search the gun locker
steps.warning: No highlighting for the open chest available

steps.text: Open and search the repair locker
steps.warning: No highlighting for the open chest available

steps.text: Take 3 gunpowder from the powder barrel
Take a barrel from the barrel stack
Use the gunpowder on the chain
Use the anvil to smith the heated chain and cannonball together
Use your cannonball and chain on the barrel to receive a cannonball barrel-boat
Go back up the ladder to the main deck. On the eastern cannon, choose 'Take-The-Ride' option to go to Bloodsplatter Isle.

steps.title: Investigating Bloodsplatter Isle
steps.text: Investigate the Perch Rock.  You must steer him around while dropping cannonballs on the Barrelchests.
steps.warning: Ensure chat text is on or filtered to have automatic progression of the plugin.

steps.text: Leave the Isle by diving at the pier and swim.
Climb the ladder and talk to Bill on his ship, request to go to Bloodsplatter Isle.

actions.text: Can you take me to Bloodsplatter Isle?

steps.text: Walk in to the middle of the factory building in order to get caught.
Escape your cell and Barrelchest parts (abscond with shelf)
Get a surgical mask.
Get a roll of bandage.
Get a barrel from the stack
Return to Bill by using the signalling point at the end of the dock where you arrived.
Get the Barrelchest disguise from Bill.

actions.text: I've gathered the things you asked for.

postconditions.text: Ye should be able to wander

steps.text: Talk to Bill again and have him send you back to the island.

actions.text: Can you take me to Bloodsplatter Isle?

steps.text: Enter the the factory and take 3 barrels from the stack and 3 gunpowder from the barrel - where you picked up the supplies for the Barrelchest disguise.

steps.title: Collecting evidence
steps.text: Change into the Barrelchest disguise. Must be 3x3 clear around your character.
Letter One: Go to the south-west room, sabotage the southern gas canister. 'Tell-joke' to each of the Dis-orderly and then brutalise each of them. Investigate the noticeboard.
steps.warning: Ensure chat text is on or filtered for automatic progression in the plugin.

steps.text: Letter Two: Kill each of Grimterns in the western-most room. Investigate the noticeboard after killing them.

postconditions.text: Phew. That's the last of them

steps.text: Letter Three: Talk to one of the drunk zombies lying on the beds in the north-west room, then investigate the noticeboard.
Letter Four: Loosen each of the three undead arms in the north-east room, then inspect one of the arms, finally investigate the noticeboard.
steps.warning: Highlighting is cluncky on this step.

steps.text: Letter Five: This step requires at least 300 life points. Use the three gunpowder on the barrels in your backpack. Then in the south-eastern room, finish-building on each of the three incomplete barrelchest stations, then detonate one of them to destroy all three. Finally, investigate the noticeboard.
Change out of the barrelchest disguise from your backpack. Changing in the middle of the factory gets you caught.
Return back to Bill by signalling him from the dock to the south.

steps.title: Destroying the factory construction line
steps.text: Talk to Bill onboard his ship and show him the evidence files. Then return to Bloodsplatter Isle (without disguise)

actions.text: Can you take me to Bloodsplatter Isle?

steps.text: Head back into the factory, enter the easternmost room and pull the lever.

Left-click the conveyor belts to load Bundle o' kegs onto them.
  • Continue loading the conveyor belts until each of the conveyor belts explode.
  • You can safely ignore the zombies that make it to you; killing them does nothing and they automatically die when all three belts explode.

steps.title: Battle at sea
steps.text: Jump over the destroyed wall between the conveyor lines, and head east through the door opening to the docks.

Board the unoccupied zomboat and sink all the boats.
  • Fire cannonballs at the boats either by left-clicking on them, or using the minigame menu.
  • Don't forget to repair your boat when it gets to about 25% health - it is not instant and you can only repair while your boat is at a stand still.
After you sink all of the other boats, climb up the east ladder and talk to Bill on his ship.
Head back to the basement in Joe's pub.
Talk to Bill to finish the quest.
